illustration_style: Bold mid-century-inspired gouache illustration for an adult Christmas party invitation, combining simplified graphic forms with an energetic handcrafted print feel.
line_weight: Fine to medium outlines with occasional heavier contour accents.
line_quality: Softly imperfect dark-ink contours, dry-brush edges and lightly irregular hand-drawn marks.
detail_level: Moderate detail: strong simplified silhouettes and large colour fields, with selective small decorative accents and clearly protected event-information space.
background_density: Airy, graphic backgrounds with broad calm areas; decorative detail stays at the edges so wording remains highly legible.
composition: Clear visual hierarchy led by an expressive headline, one strong central illustration and a well-defined event-details block; use generous negative space and balanced asymmetry.
palette: Rich, limited festive palette of cobalt blue, tomato red, warm cream and spruce green, supported by small deep-ink and warm golden accents.
shading: Mostly flat gouache colour blocks with sparse painted highlights, subtle tonal variation and minimal dimensional shading.
texture: Visible dry-brush gouache grain, lightly mottled pigment and a tactile uncoated-paper print character.
mood: Lively, cosy, stylish and celebratory, with an adult winter-party atmosphere.
print_considerations: Use solid but not overly saturated colour areas, high-contrast type and comfortably sized detail fields for reliable A4 and US Letter home printing; retain a clean trim-safe perimeter and avoid fine low-contrast texture behind text.
shared_prompt: Bold mid-century-inspired gouache illustration with simplified graphic forms, visible dry-brush pigment, softly imperfect dark-ink contours and a tactile uncoated-paper print feel. Use a rich limited palette of cobalt, tomato red, warm cream and spruce green, with small warm-gold accents, flat painted colour blocks, sparse highlights and crisp blue-hour contrast. Maintain lively adult festive energy, elegant balanced asymmetry, generous breathing room and highly legible typography areas; pair expressive retro display lettering with clean modern sans-serif details.
avoid: Any copied or recognisable composition, lettering, logo, artwork or branding from existing ski, alpine or Christmas designs
Photorealism, glossy 3D rendering or hyper-detailed realism
Childish cartoon styling or juvenile novelty graphics
Overcrowded layouts, busy texture behind event details or weak information hierarchy
Misspelled text, illegible display lettering or placeholder-like event details
Neon-heavy colour schemes, excessive gradients or metallic effects that reproduce poorly at home
